name: Juanca's Bakery
address: 1524 Hancock Bridge Pkwy, Cape Coral, FL 33990, United States
address_source: Google Maps business listing detail page
email_note: No public email found. Instagram API lookups for likely handles (juancasbakery, juanca.bakery) returned blocked/empty responses twice, per 2-attempt limit; followed with no further IG attempts. TikTok page (their only public web presence) does not expose an email in what is reachable without login.
has_own_site_note: Google Maps website field points to https://www.tiktok.com/@juanca.bakery — TikTok is a social platform, not an owned domain, so it does not count as an own website per pipeline rules. No separate domain found.
language_note: Primary language set to Spanish: menu items are Cuban-Spanish terms (croquetas, pastelitos, brazo gitano), Google profile shows "Identifies as Latino-owned", and sibling Cuban bakery J&J Paradise Bakery (same city) uses es as default. Google reviews found happen to be in English, included verbatim in their original language per rules.
services_mentioned: brazo gitano (guava / dulce de leche / chocolate)
tortas de celebracion por encargo (incl. viral TikTok guava cake)
comida casera cubana (pollo frito, arroz, tostones)

review_samples.author: Natan Saidon
review_samples.text: Nice little Cuban bakery, mom-and-pop diner atmosphere. One of those tiny places in Cape Coral you wouldn't even notice unless you knew it was there.

review_samples.author: Kathleen Hawkins
review_samples.text: I've been searching for years for good guava treats for my husband. I came across a tiktok video of a guava cake they made, and it did not disappoint.

review_samples.author: Royalty Padding
review_samples.text: Juanca's Bakery is a true gem. Every visit has been a great experience. The food is fresh, the service is outstanding.

review_samples.author: Nina R
review_samples.text: It is a tiny restaurant/cafe but they are always organized and give good service, the coffee is great and the pastries too.

photos_source: Google Maps photo viewer (gmaps_photocycle.js), 6 photos pulled, 1 exact duplicate removed, 5 unique real photos used (hero/about/gallery), all food shots (cake rolls, croquetas/empanadas, eclairs, pastelitos, a prepared plate).
photo_count_note: 5 is the pipeline hard minimum for usable real photos; all 5 passed visual review (no closed-eyes, no captions overlaid, no blur).
discovery_method: node scripts/gmaps_discover.js "bakery pasteleria in Cape Coral, FL" 4 and "panaderia cubana in Cape Coral, FL" 4 -> rating 5.0 / 161 reviews, website field pointed to TikTok only, verified with gmaps_detail.js.
dedup_check: Not present in data/processed.json (checked by name/phone against city filter Cape Coral|Fort Myers|Naples). An existing output/jj-paradise-bakery-cape-coral (different business, same city/niche) was found and left untouched.
